Definition: Lo-Ammi, the symbolic name of a son of Hosea
BiblicalUsage: Lo-ammi means 'not my people' — the symbolic name God gave to Hosea's son. In Hosea 1:9, "Call his name Lo-ammi: for ye [are] not my people".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Lo-ammi is the hardest name in the Bible — ye are not my people — and it is also the promise, because the God who named him so will one day say thou art my people again.
